description.narrative: The project is implemented in Bosnia and Herzegovina. The main outcome area it contributes to is equality and workers' rights and gender equality. The main right holders are trade union members and workers within the commerces and services sector, especially youth and women. Through free legal aid, dissemination of information and alliance-building, the project aims to achieve progressive development within the outcome areas.Project OrganisationsThe project is a cooperation between the Commerce Trade and Services Trade Union of Bosnia and Herzegovina (STBiH), Handelsanstlldas frbund and The Palme Center. Both organisations are the main unions for employees of the commerce sector in their respective countries. STBiH is one of few trade unions in BiH that organises members in both entities.Other Donors to the OrganisationNorwegian Union of Commerce and Office Employees (HK)Project ObjectiveThe project objective is a stronger and more influential trade union organisation that is more democratic, more transparent, more connected to other civil society organizations, organisation that is opened and attractive for young workers and successful in organising in small and in large national and multinational companies in Bosnia and Herzegovina (both entities, FBIH and RS). STBIH goal is to be recognised as an authority and role model for other unions, like new and modern union with different approaches and appropriate services and initiatives in the labour market in BiH and in the region.Actor groups--Decision makers-- Parliaments and governments at entity levels Economical and Social Councils --Actors in Cooperation-- Trade unions in BiH Civil sector in general Social democratic parties Employers Media --Rights holders-- Members of STBiH Workers in the commerce and services sectors
